records.title: v9.2 Spawn Discipline (self-audit fix)
records.description: R0n Grilled: "you slip out of rules, subagents don't get spawned in long chats — figure out why." Root cause: rules live in prose; runtime doesn't enforce them; per-turn greedy opt
records.body:
**Date:** 2026-09-10

**Decision:** **v9.2 Spawn Discipline (self-audit fix)**

**Rationale:** R0n Grilled: "you slip out of rules, subagents don't get spawned in long chats — figure out why." Root cause: rules live in prose; runtime doesn't enforce them; per-turn greedy optimization ("just do it well inline") beats multi-turn protocol. FIX: (1) DEFAULT is Agent-spawn, exception is inline — skill-loading followed inline is personation, banned. (2) Must-spawn triggers by task-pattern (not tier): quote/PI/PO → EDIDTH; 3D/brand/deck → FRIDAY; deploy-repo code → VERONICA; specialty pool → DUM-E. (3) Skip visibility: `[SKIPPED: <agent> — <reason>]` inline whenever I don't spawn something a trigger requires. Silent skips are the disease. Complementary harness fix drafted in scratchpad `spawn-gate-draft.md` — R0n owns installing the PreToolUse hook that BLOCKS Write/Edit on quote/deploy paths without a preceding Agent spawn. Prose alone will decay; hooks won't. Charter SKILL.md updated under `### v9.2 Spawn Discipline`. Feedback memory saved as `feedback_subagent_spawn_discipline`. Domain LAW #0 added.

**Ruled out:** Adding more prose rules only (does not solve it — prose decays; hooks don't) · Scrapping the subagent system (R0n: "don't scrap you")

records.body: **Headless Chrome clamps its window to ~500px minimum width.** `--window-size=375,780` silently lays out at **vw=500** and then crops the screenshot to 375 — text looks "clipped" and you will chase a CSS bug that does not exist (burned real time 2026-07-09). `--force-device-scale-factor` does NOT shrink the CSS viewport either. To test narrow layouts: **measure, don't screenshot** — dump `documentElement.scrollWidth > innerWidth` via `--dump-dom`, or force `html{width:375px}` (but remember viewport media queries then still match the real width, so media-query-dependent rules won't reflect mobile).

records.title: Infinite `requestAnimationFrame` loops stall `--print-to-pdf`.
records.description: **Infinite `requestAnimationFrame` loops stall `--print-to-pdf`.** Virtual time never goes idle, so Chrome hangs forever (no PDF, no error). Fix: render the PDF with `--force-prefers-reduced-motion` s
records.body: **Infinite `requestAnimationFrame` loops stall `--print-to-pdf`.** Virtual time never goes idle, so Chrome hangs forever (no PDF, no error). Fix: render the PDF with `--force-prefers-reduced-motion` so the single-draw path runs and rAF loops never start. Screenshots are unaffected (they fire at budget expiry). Also: always bound the wait with `WaitForExit(ms)` + `Kill()`, never a bare `-Wait`.

records.body: **`--screenshot` ignores runtime scroll.** `window.scrollTo()` before capture does nothing (and `scroll-behavior:smooth` freezes under virtual time anyway). To capture a lower section, inject `body{margin-top:-Npx}` into a temp copy.

records.description: **Curving flat modules = faceted arc, not a smooth bend.** On the LED Wall Planner (2026-06-25) two curve models shipped and both scattered the cabinets: (1) vertices-over-`cols-1` + chord radius, (2)
records.body: **Curving flat modules = faceted arc, not a smooth bend.** On the LED Wall Planner (2026-06-25) two curve models shipped and both scattered the cabinets: (1) vertices-over-`cols-1` + chord radius, (2) centres-on-arc + arc-length radius `wW/A`. Both only hold for many columns + small angle; few columns + big angle exposes them. Correct model is **chord-vertex** (each panel a chord, chord-solved radius `cW/(2·sin(Δθ/2))`, placed at chord midpoints, sharing corner vertices). Now codified in the `curved-led-wall` skill — use it, don't re-derive.
